1.web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
1.asv: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

2.web: You, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? then cause her to know all her abominations.
2.asv: And thou, son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? then cause her to know all her abominations.

3.web: You shall say, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: A city that sheds blood in the midst of her, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!
3.asv: And thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A city that sheddeth blood in the midst of her, that her time may come, and that maketh idols against herself to defile her!

4.web: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made; and you have caused your days to draw near, and have come even to your years: therefore have I made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.
4.asv: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed, and art defiled in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.

5.web: Those who are near, and those who are far from you, shall mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.
5.asv: Those that are near, and those that are far from thee, shall mock thee, thou infamous one and full of tumult.

6.web: Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.
6.asv: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one according to his power, have been in thee to shed blood.

7.web: In you have they set light by father and mother; in your midst have they dealt by oppression with the foreigner; in you have they wronged the fatherless and the widow.
7.asv: In thee have they set light by father and mother; in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the sojourner; in thee have they wronged the fatherless and the widow.

8.web: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
8.asv: Thou hast despised my holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

9.web: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood; and in you they have eaten on the mountains: in your midst they have committed lewdness.
9.asv: Slanderous men have been in thee to shed blood; and in thee they have eaten upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they have committed lewdness.

10.web: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness; in you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.
10.asv: In thee have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness; in thee have they humbled her that was unclean in her impurity.

11.web: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife; and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law; and another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
11.asv: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

12.web: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood; you have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me, says the Lord Yahweh.
12.asv: In thee have they taken bribes to shed blood; thou hast taken interest and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbors by oppression, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

13.web: Behold, therefore, I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at your blood which has been in your midst.
13.asv: Behold, therefore, I have smitten my hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

14.web: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with you? I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and will do it.
14.asv: Can thy heart endure, or can thy hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I, Jehovah, have spoken it, and will do it.

15.web: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries; and I will consume your filthiness out of you.
15.asv: And I will scatter thee among the nations, and disperse thee through the countries; and I will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

16.web: You shall be profaned in yourself, in the sight of the nations; and you shall know that I am Yahweh.
16.asv: And thou shalt be profaned in thyself, in the sight of the nations; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

17.web: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
17.asv: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

18.web: Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me: all of them are brass and tin and iron and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are the dross of silver.
18.asv: Son of man, the house of Israel is become dross unto me: all of them are brass and tin and iron and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are the dross of silver.

19.web: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
19.asv: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye are all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

20.web: As they gather silver and brass and iron and lead and tin into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it; so will I gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there, and melt you.
20.asv: As they gather silver and brass and iron and lead and tin into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there, and melt you.

21.web: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you shall be melted in its midst.
21.asv: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you with the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

22.web: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so you will be melted in its midst; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have poured out my wrath on you.
22.asv: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have poured out my wrath upon you.

23.web: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
23.asv: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

24.web: Son of man, tell her, You are a land that is not cleansed, nor rained on in the day of indignation.
24.asv: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art a land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

25.web: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in its midst, like a roaring lion ravening the prey: they have devoured souls; they take treasure and precious things; they have made her widows many in its midst.
25.asv: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey: they have devoured souls; they take treasure and precious things; they have made her widows many in the midst thereof.

26.web: Her priests have done violence to my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
26.asv: Her priests have done violence to my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

27.web: Her princes in its midst are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.
27.asv: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

28.web: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, Thus says the Lord Yahweh, when Yahweh has not spoken.
28.asv: And her prophets have daubed for them with untempered mortar, seeing false visions, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, when Jehovah hath not spoken.

29.web: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery; yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.
29.asv: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery; yea, they have vexed the poor and needy, and have oppressed the sojourner wrongfully.

30.web: I sought for a man among them, who should build up the wall, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found no one.
30.asv: And I sought for a man among them, that should build up the wall, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found none.

31.web: Therefore have I poured out my indignation on them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I brought on their heads, says the Lord Yahweh.
31.asv: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I brought upon their heads, saith the Lord Jehovah.
